title: 標籤寫三十九
subject: a shopper who finds the yellow shelf tag on a pack of toilet paper says 39 but the till rings 49, marches the cashier back to the shelf, makes the manager rip the tag down with his price gun, and an old man behind him quietly brings his own pack over too
caption: Mandarin Oi! street punk, mid-tempo terrace-chant style. Overdriven bar-chord electric guitars; a melodic bass running between the chords; stomping, straight mid-tempo drums with snare on every backbeat; a big gang-shout choir. Live pub-gig punch with room-mic crowd shouts. Male gravelly baritone, half-shouted chant delivery, crowd gang vocals answering each hook line. 138 BPM, D major. Stubborn, rowdy and righteous. No pop-punk polish, no hardcore blast beats, no metal riffs, no synths, no autotune.
lyrics:
[Intro - shouted count-in, stomping drums, bar chords]

[Verse 1]
貨架上那串衛生紙
黃色標籤寫三十九
結帳一刷四十九
收銀員說 系統是這樣

[Pre-Chorus]
我說妳跟我來
我們去看看那張標籤

[Chorus]
標籤寫三十九
標籤寫三十九
不是我要吵
是它自己寫的

[Verse 2]
店長從倉庫跑出來
手上還拿著標價槍
他看看標籤 看看我
把那張黃紙撕下來

[Pre-Chorus]
後面排隊的阿伯
默默把他那串也拿過來

[Chorus]
標籤寫三十九
標籤寫三十九
阿伯也要吵
他也拍了照

[Outro - gang shout over stomping drums]
